claims.claim: Platform-neutral immutable multi-observation contract accepts between 2 and 100 ProductSourcePack observations and returns exact identities, pairwise resolutions, and auditable consistency diagnostics without catalog or source mutation.
For N valid unique observations, delegates exactly once to pairwise entity resolution for each unordered pair, returning N * (N - 1) / 2 preserved pairwise results.
Duplicate SourceObservationIdentity fails deterministically before pairwise evaluation, while observations sharing source_pack_id with distinct observed_at values remain distinct valid observations.
Permuting input order produces consistent semantic observations, pairwise decisions, and consistency diagnostics.
Pairwise results preserve relationship, confidence, reasons, evidence, and both SourceObservationIdentity values without rewriting or aggregation.
Direct DIFFERENT_PRODUCT relationships occurring within a positive product-family chain report an auditable ProductFamilyConsistencyConflict referencing contributing pairs without merging or repair.
UNCERTAIN relationships do not create positive family connectivity or consistency conflicts.
Fully consistent positive family sets return no consistency conflicts and do not create cluster IDs, canonical product IDs, or inferred transitive pair results.
Invalid cardinality (<2 or >100) and duplicate exact identities fail deterministically without partial pairwise work or external side effects.

Deterministic unit tests cover bounded cardinality, exact pair count, single pairwise delegation, repeated-listing observations, duplicate rejection, permutation, consistency, and UNCERTAIN boundaries with zero external side effects.

M3 documentation describes the multi-observation resolution graph as a read-only evidence and conflict boundary, explicitly deferring clustering, merge approval, canonical IDs, persistence, aggregation, retrieval, and RAG.
